# S6 chord experiment (local, 2026-10-24; generated by `node scripts/exp-chords.ts`)


Model qwen3:8b via a local stand-in (scripts/local_llm_shim.py: llama.cpp with the official Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M GGUF, thinking off; same model and quantization family as the node, different runtime and GPU). 24 outputs from 36 calls; valid 20/24 after repairs, 17/24 on the first try. Latency per call: median 7100 ms, p90 11096 ms, max 12155 ms.

Fit = duration-weighted share of melody time on chord tones (all / notes starting on strong beats). Ref = per-beat agreement with the SATB-derived chords (root / exact). Objective = reference-free selection score.
